description: Reconciling a note that changed on both sides: same text, clean three-way merge, otherwise the newest version wins (ties go to the drive) and the other one is saved as a conflicted copy with a new id. newestWins includes copyModifiedMillis (the losing edit time), conflictCopyIntent (SHA-256 hashes of exact UTF-8 sources, nullable baseHash), and reuseCopy. Optional input.conflictCopyIntent and existingCopy {path,text,modifiedMillis} allow verified durable replay.

cases.name: same text
non-overlapping edits merge
overlapping edits: newer local wins

knownDivergence.android: The pinned sync library lacks copyModifiedMillis and durable verified conflict-copy replay; requires the 0.3 reconcile contract.
